purpose: Define the only explicit path for reducing or transforming DWH taint: an authorized declared sanitization/declassification operation with evidence, scope and resulting classification.

topics.name: DWH Sanitization and Declassification
topics.purpose: Define the only explicit path for reducing or transforming DWH taint: an authorized declared sanitization/declassification operation with evidence, scope and resulting classification.

semantics.operation_rule: Sanitization/declassification is an explicit canonical operation/transformation identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Operation requires explicit authority/policy approval for the affected classification.
semantics.evidence_rule: Result records source taint, transformation, authority/policy and resulting taint state.
semantics.scope_rule: Declassification applies only to the exact transformed output scope.
semantics.partial_rule: An operation may remove one taint dimension while preserving others.
semantics.failure_rule: If sanitization cannot prove its declared post-condition, output retains applicable source taint or operation fails.

invariants.rule: DWH lineage and taint state remain explicit, monotonic unless an authorized transformation says otherwise, and traceable to source evidence.

hard_gates.condition: taint disappears without explicit sanitization/declassification operation
declassification broadens beyond exact transformed output
failed sanitization still emits clean-classified output

references.purpose: Default propagation remains monotonic unless explicitly declassified.

prose.summary: Define the only explicit path for reducing or transforming DWH taint: an authorized declared sanitization/declassification operation with evidence, scope and resulting classification.
